fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Florida gambling policy and enforcement, criticizing monopolistic gambling interests (including Col. E. R. Bradley) and advocating legalization/regulation; an exposé on loan sharks and usury practices in Miami; discussion of slot machines and marble-machine gambling; and a column warning about fake racing tipsters alongside horse-racing notes and forecasts. Also includes local society/campus chatter and assorted local advertisements.
